purpose: Profile-B stability evidence, graded by modelability (S0-S4 per task section 6.5). No fabricated timescales.

modelability_levels.S0: No usable stability evidence - animation must NOT show definitive aggregation/precipitation
modelability_levels.S1: Qualitative evidence - animation may show a risk state, NOT a precise onset time
modelability_levels.S2: Quantitative endpoint evidence (e.g. size/PDI before & after a defined period) - endpoint changes with explicit interpolation assumptions
modelability_levels.S3: Quantitative time-series evidence - time-dependent change within the measured domain

api_crystallization.evidence: DSC: tripterine melting peaks (175.7/211.4 C) ABSENT in the NLC -> celastrol amorphous/molecularly dispersed -> low crystallization risk WITHIN the carrier

colloidal_size_PDI_zeta_time_series.evidence: NO size/PDI/zeta-vs-time data reported in the paper

storage_stability.evidence: intro claims NLCs have 'limited drug leakage during storage' - GENERIC class claim, not a measured Chen time-series

presets.net: S1 for API-crystallization risk (amorphous); S0 for colloidal aggregation/precipitation timing. Animation may show a stable dispersion + a qualitative post-release precipitation-RISK cue, but NOT a deterministic aggregation/precipitation clock.

presets.note: search mentions storage stability assessed; VALUES UNVERIFIED. Level pending full text (potentially S2 if before/after size/PDI reported).
search mentions 'storage stability assessment' in QC; VALUES UNVERIFIED. Level pending full text.
stability not characterized in search snippet; pending full text.

general_celastrol_stability.chemical_instability: celastrol is chemically unstable under aqueous/physiological/oxidative conditions (consensus reviews PMC7751759, PMC10904542) - qualitative, NOT time-resolved here
general_celastrol_stability.beta_CD_complex: SBE-betaCD complexation reported to reduce degradation (S1_celastrol_beta_cyclodextrin) - values UNVERIFIED
general_celastrol_stability.implication: released celastrol degradation is a real RISK; without compatible time-series it stays a qualitative warning, not a modeled rate

overall_conclusion: No Profile-B preset currently has S3 (time-series) colloidal-stability or precipitation data opened in this project. Precise time-to-aggregation / time-to-precipitation CANNOT be modeled. Only qualitative risk states (S1) and the amorphous-state crystallization argument are supported.
